state_reads: keyword abilities as each damage step begins
timing: a second real combat damage step follows the first
priority occurs after each damage step
choices: combat damage is assigned independently in each applicable step
layers: current ability-adding and ability-removing effects are evaluated at each step
replacement_effects: damage replacement and prevention remain delegated to the damage pipeline
copy: copiable characteristics may supply double strike
control_change: a creature removed from combat no longer participates
zone_change: only remaining attackers and blockers participate
source_leaves: a departed combatant does not assign later damage

variants: blocked creature remains blocked after its blocker dies
recompute trample assignment in the second step
lose double strike after step one
gain double strike after first-strike damage

implementation.component: mtg_commander_sim.combat and CommanderEngine combat-damage step state machine

known_blockers: full continuous-effect dependencies, copy, and face-down characteristic evaluation remain incomplete
the universal simultaneous damage replacement/prevention pipeline remains incomplete
combat-damage trigger batching before priority remains incomplete
